agreement: Agree means: in both Figma and code, the same value in every mode, the CSS name matches the Figma WEB code syntax, and tokens.css matches tokens.json. Descriptions are not part of agreement. A token whose override is no longer needed still agrees. The total is every token in Figma or in code.

A state shown only by a colour change of a 1 pixel line is easy to miss.
WCAG 2.4.13 measures a focus indicator against a 2 pixel perimeter.
The gap keeps the blue ring readable beside a pink or black fill.
Radius has height/32, so a 32 pixel control exists in the design; nothing names its height.
Radius has height/40.
Radius has height/44.
32 and 40 pixel controls are small for a thumb. WCAG 2.2 AA asks 24; Apple and WCAG AAA ask 44.
